objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document; differentiates documents such as policies, guidelines, procedural instructions and work instructions.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to structure documents in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data such as IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained for relevant companies.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained for areas of validity.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document, adaptable to different requirements.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Assigned consecutive number of the document.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained automatically or by the user.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the document, retained and updated through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current document status such as editing, released or out of force.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Existing source format used to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via a User Group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute identifying the registered author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for additional personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute identifying reviewers assigned to the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute identifying releasers assigned to the document, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity starts, based on release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate extended validity; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification for existing User Groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks for existing User Groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language used to determine visibility of released language versions to authorized readers.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of clients in which a document is visible or not.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons within a guideline framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for sub-processes or departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Document supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Document supplement that can be added to work instructions.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached when creating a new document, additional information, attachment or request.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format such as Excel, Word or PowerPoint used to generate new documents.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information that is not subject to the main document release cycle.

attributes.name: criticality
attributes.description: Lack of criticality allows direct deletion and release/publication via switches.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment associated with a main document and automatically released with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Own versioning of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status passed through in the release process of the main document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Relevant equipment mentioned as additional detail with which documents can be supplemented.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to groups of users or persons for each document.

attributes.name: read_right
attributes.description: Right to view approved or archived documents.

attributes.name: change_right
attributes.description: Right to change documents and related details.

attributes.name: write_access
attributes.description: Access permitting creation of requests for AKS for a selected document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user participating in document management, workflows, distribution and acknowledgements.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System or license role assigned to the user.

attributes.name: read_permission
attributes.description: Permission assigned to authors, reviewers, releasers or readers on documents and details.

attributes.name: write_permission
attributes.description: Permission assigned to authors, reviewers and releasers on documents and details.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for roles, authorizations, reader assignment, distribution and archive access.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION such as Reader - Document Management.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role indicated in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: reader_group
objs.description: User group whose users can take note of documents and may include additional subgroups.

objs.name: author_group
objs.description: User group whose users are offered in the author or co-author selection list for documents.

objs.name: reviewer_group
objs.description: User group whose users are offered in the reviewer selection list for documents.

objs.name: releaser_group
objs.description: User group whose users are offered in the releaser selection list for documents.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents when other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual person assigned personal authorizations and included in distribution lists.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Person or user who creates a document, proposal or request.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Registered author who signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person assigned additional change rights without relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for the document and its content and for deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who can translate released DHC VISION content into another language but cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: workflow_participant
objs.description: User involved in workflow tasks and completing tasks with electronic signature.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature documented for individual workflow participants for each released version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task in the workflow whose status and existence are communicated to involved users.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: E-mail information sent by the system for workflow tasks, change proposals, distribution and acknowledgements.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that can be created and managed without affecting content or version history.

attributes.name: implementation_schedule
attributes.description: Whether the change proposal is scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: editing_documentation
attributes.description: Documentation by the author of the editing of assigned change proposals.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Indicates completed change proposals that are no longer displayed in the document.

objs.name: cockpit
objs.description: Document area in which change proposals and distribution lists are maintained and displayed.

objs.name: folder
objs.description: Container such as the Change proposals folder or folder for reactivation requests.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is nearing expiry.

attributes.name: pending_status
attributes.description: Indicates a pending extension of validity.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate or override a selected document.

attributes.name: documentation_purpose
attributes.description: Request is retained after declaration of Out of force for documentation purposes.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Creator of the request for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to document distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_by_e_mail
attributes.description: Distribution type informing assigned users and assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution type requesting active acknowledgement from assigned persons and users of assigned User Groups upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation that users have taken note of documents, documented and summarized for authors or key roles.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in acknowledgement reports.

attributes.name: confirmation
attributes.description: Active confirmation by recipients for acknowledgement distribution.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled using document distribution groups.

attributes.name: document_list
attributes.description: Dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter influencing report evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion filtering report result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light
attributes.description: Traffic light display for status or workflow aging.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Instruction stored in the system and evaluated by status reports.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version that must be released before translation.

attributes.name: released_state
attributes.description: State required for translated content to become visible to authorized readers.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data such as IT applications to which documents can be automatically linked.
